s.note: Mick's camp in the Top End
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk to a soft dough, shape into a round and score a cross. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

m.how: Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.

w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 4 passionfruit and a sliced mango.

d.n: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
d.note: back in Mick's Top End country after the ambush
d.how: Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.
